commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+3' The free kick from long range, taken by Nice, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+2' Matthieu Udol (Metz) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) replaces Jeremie Boga.
87' Fali Cande (Metz) is able to continue to play.
86' Fali Cande (Metz) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
84' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a change. Badredine Bouanani (Nice) replaces Gaetan Laborde.
84' We are about to witness a subsitution. Romain Perraud (Nice) for Melvin Bard.
83' A corner kick by Nice is thwarted by the well prepared Alexandre Oukidja (Metz).

82' Evann Guessand (Nice) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the bottom left corner. Alexandre Oukidja has a clear sight of it makes a comfortable save. Nice have a corner.
78' Joel Asoro (Metz) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for an infringement. Nice earn a free kick.
78' Here is a change. Danley Jean Jacques is going off and Laszlo Boloni gives the last tactical orders to Arthur Atta (Metz).
78' Substitution. Oscar Estupinan did his best and is replaced by Simon Elisor (Metz).
76' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
74' Melvin Bard (Nice) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jerome Brisard has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Metz win a free kick.
71' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. It's a free kick to Nice in a dangerous position.
70' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Joel Asoro (Metz) replacing Ablie Jallow.
70' Here comes a substitution. Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) is brought on as a substitute for Koffi Kouao.
69' Matthieu Udol (Metz) commits a rough foul. Jerome Brisard stops the game and makes a call. Nice have a free kick.
67' Metz concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. A free kick has been awarded to Nice.
67' Francesco Farioli decides to make a substitution. Terem Moffi will be replaced by Evann Guessand (Nice).
66' Terem Moffi (Nice) picks up an injury.
65' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
64' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Pape Diallo as he is replaced by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz).
63' Terem Moffi (Nice) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
62' The shot by Fali Cande (Metz) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Marcin Bulka.
61' Pape Diallo (Metz) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
60' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Alexandre Oukidja, who smothers the ball.
58' A fine pass finds Terem Moffi (Nice) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Alexandre Oukidja reacts superbly to deny him.
56' The possession of the ball – 32:68.
54' A pass lands at the feet of Gaetan Laborde (Nice) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.

50' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jerome Brisard blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Metz, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
50' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
48' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
46' Francesco Farioli has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Morgan Sanson (Nice) comes on the pitch for Khephren Thuram.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
42' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle and it's Terem Moffi (Nice) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Metz are awarded a free kick.
40' Ablie Jallow (Metz) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
39' The resulting set piece from Metz is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
38' Matthieu Udol (Metz) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Metz will take a corner kick.
34' 1:2 – this is the current number of shots on target.
30' Jeremie Boga (Nice) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Alexandre Oukidja makes a comfortable save.
29' Terem Moffi (Nice) makes a rough challenge and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Metz.
28' Oscar Estupinan (Metz) gets on the end of a pass and takes a low shot from the edge of the box which is straight at Marcin Bulka, who makes a comfortable save.
26' Dante (Nice) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
26' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.

26' Jeremie Boga (Nice) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Nice force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
25' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Jeremie Boga (Nice). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
24' Melvin Bard (Nice) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Corner kick. Nice will have an opportunity.

22' Oscar Estupinan (Metz) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
21' Jerome Brisard shows a yellow card to Khephren Thuram (Nice) for his blatant foul.
16' A cross is whipped into the box by Gaetan Laborde (Nice) and Terem Moffi controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
14' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Melvin Bard sprays a pass out to Hicham Boudaoui (Nice), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
13' The Nice players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
11' Ablie Jallow (Metz) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A free kick to Nice.
10' Koffi Kouao (Metz) sends a cross into the box, but Marcin Bulka comes off his line to gather the ball.
8' Wonderful movement by Nice. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
6' Nice take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
5' Terem Moffi (Nice) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Nice.

3' Khephren Thuram (Nice) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Metz.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Metz will have the kick-off.
Jerome Brisard is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
